opcode_replace.note: Build 0159/OPEN-017: pass-sequence table base pointer relocation. `move.l #0x00050F6B, %d0` at arcade 0x0503CE loads the PC080SN pass-sequence table base into a DATA register; the postpatch shift-relocation only shifts abs.l control-transfer/LEA operands, so this data-register immediate was NOT relocated +0x200 (its sibling `movea.l #0x00050EE0, %a1` at 0x0503BC WAS, -> 0x000510E0). On Genesis the un-relocated pointer reads ROM[0x050F6B]=0x80 instead of the correct relocated ROM[0x05116B]=0x00 (arcade ROM[0x050F6B]=0x00), so a5@0x10C6 lands 0x200 too low and the desc-rebuild sets the tilemap PASS SELECTOR a5@0x10A8=0x0080 (FG) instead of 0x0000 (BG). Arcade always selects BG (a5@0x10A8==0) for the Stage 1 collision/tilemap pass. Fix relocates ONLY this data-register immediate 0x00050F6B -> 0x0005116B (byte-neutral, opcode 0x203C preserved; movel #imm,Dn is not in the shift-adjust set so the replacement is not re-shifted). No NOP, no destination patch, no forced value, no collision emission, no 0x10DE00 rebase. Same missed-data-register-literal class as Build 0158 (0x05102E).

The arcade sound-command dispatcher (arcade 0x03A126, runtime 0x3A326) busy-waits at runtime 0x3A33E-0x3A346 (`bsr 0x3F29C; btst #0,d0; bne`) for bit 0 (busy) to clear; the sole caller uses only bit 0 of d0 and overwrites d0 immediately after. Replace the read with `andi.l #0xFFFFFFFE,%d0` (byte-exact 6->6, NO nops, no branch change) so bit 0 always reads clear = sound ready, letting the existing loop fall through to 0x3A348. Proof: Tighe observed Exodus spinning at 0x3A342/0x3A346 (strict open-bus returns bit 0 set); MAME/BlastEm pass only because their open-bus returns bit 0 clear (MAME measured 0x3E0003=0x00). Complements the existing TC0140SYT WRITE suppression (reset/bank writes) which left the read-side handshake unowned. Do NOT NOP the loop or force the branch. Future follow-up: optional real Genesis Z80 sound handshake via sound_comm.s/z80_write_command.
